skills.name: Summon Unstable Familiar
skills.description:
Command the powers of Oblivion to send a Daedric familiar to fight at your side. The familiar's attacks deal |cffffff1301|r Shock Damage.

Once summoned, you can activate the familiar's special ability for |cffffff3405|r Magicka, dealing |cffffff1577|r Shock Damage every |cffffff2|r seconds for |cffffff20|r seconds to enemies near them.

The familiar remains until killed or unsummoned.

skills.name: Swallow Soul
skills.description:
Steal an enemy's life force, dealing |cffffff10090|r Magic Damage and healing you for |cffffff33|r% of the damage inflicted every |cffffff2|r seconds for |cffffff10|r seconds.

Deals |cffffff1|r% more damage for every |cffffff2|r% Health you have.
